sentences.text:
This petition is filed by the petitioner/accused No.4 challenging the proceedings in PCR No.1/2018,
on the file of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Hassan for the offences punishable under Sections 13(1)(c) , (d), (e) and 13(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 and Sections 409 and 420 read with Section 34 of IPC.

entities.text: Principal District and Sessions Judge, Hassan
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The impugned proceeding was challenged by accused Nos.1 and 2 before this Court in Criminal Petition No.1420/2018 and connected petition.
This Court by order dated 15.02.2023 quashed the impugned proceedings as against accused Nos.1 and 2 therein reserving liberty to the complainant to lodge a complaint afresh if, permissible in law.
Therefore, this petition requires to be disposed of in terms of the order passed in the aforesaid petition.

3. Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i.

ii. The impugned order dated 05.02.2018 passed by the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Hassan in PCR No.1/2018 referring the complaint to respondent No.1 for investigation under Section 156(3) of Cr.P.C., is hereby quashed insofar as it relates to accused No.4 herein.
iii. Liberty is reserved to the complainant to lodge a complaint afresh if, permissible in law.
iv.

entities.text: Principal District and Sessions Judge, Hassan
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The complaint stands dismissed as against petitioner/accused No.4 herein.

opennyai_summary.facts:
This petition is filed by the petitioner/accused No.4 challenging the proceedings in PCR No.1/2018,
on the file of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Hassan for the offences punishable under Sections 13(1)(c) , (d), (e) and 13(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 and Sections 409 and 420 read with Section 34 of IPC.
2. The impugned proceeding was challenged by accused Nos.1 and 2 before this Court in Criminal Petition No.1420/2018 and connected petition.
opennyai_summary.decision:
This Court by order dated 15.02.2023 quashed the impugned proceedings as against accused Nos.1 and 2 therein reserving liberty to the complainant to lodge a complaint afresh if, permissible in law.
Therefore, this petition requires to be disposed of in terms of the order passed in the aforesaid petition.
3. Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i.
The Criminal Petition is allowed.
ii. The impugned order dated 05.02.2018 passed by the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Hassan in PCR No.1/2018 referring the complaint to respondent No.1 for investigation under Section 156(3) of Cr.P.C., is hereby quashed insofar as it relates to accused No.4 herein.
iii. Liberty is reserved to the complainant to lodge a complaint afresh if, permissible in law.
iv.
The complaint stands dismissed as against petitioner/accused No.4 herein.
